requirements.requirement: Given the verified interference phenomena, any theory formulated in the Sorkin generalized-measure class (probabilities assigned by a functional over additively combinable alternatives/histories) that reproduces them must carry a non-vanishing second-order interference functional (I_2 != 0) together with a third-order functional vanishing to within the measured bound (|I_3| < 10^-2 of two-path interference) — i.e., a probability functional of degree at most 2 in the alternative-combining structure, at current experimental precision.
requirements.phenomenon_basis: VERIFIED corpus entries only (indices 0-based): quantum_mechanics/phenomena/0 — 'Single-particle and many-path interference', OBSERVED/VERIFIED (Tonomura et al., Am. J. Phys. 57, 117 (1989), single-electron two-slit buildup; Arndt et al., Nature 401, 680 (1999), C60); quantum_mechanics/phenomena/1 — 'Born-frequency statistics in repeated measurements', OBSERVED/VERIFIED (Sinha et al., Science 329, 418 (2010): three-slit experiment bounding third-order (Sorkin) interference below 10^-2 of two-path interference), carried WITH its recorded caveat: 'precision test of the pairwise interference structure underlying Born statistics; not a test of single-run outcome selection'.
requirements.formalization_relative_to: Forced relative to class F1 = generalized measure theories in the Sorkin-hierarchy sense — formulations that assign probability via a functional over combinable alternatives/histories; the path-integral formulation (quantum_mechanics/alternative_formulations/1, Feynman 1948) is the in-corpus member of F1. Corpus alternative_formulations inventoried for evaders: real-symplectic formulation (quantum_mechanics/alternative_formulations/0) is equivalent to complex-Hilbert and preserves the degree-2 pairing — not an evader; Wigner phase-space (quantum_mechanics/alternative_formulations/1) is equivalent and relocates the same bilinear structure into quasi-probability form — not an evader; the operational reconstructions (information_theory/alternative_formulations/0-2: Hardy, CDP, CBH) define no interference-order functional and sit OUTSIDE F1 — out-of-class, not evaders. NONE-FOUND as an in-corpus evading formulation within F1; search note: the requirement is FORCED* relative to F1 only, and does not attach to formulation classes lacking an additive alternative structure (such classes render it inapplicable, not violated).
requirements.arrow_evidence: In the Sorkin hierarchy, I_3 = 0 is a theorem of any degree-2 (bilinear) measure, while I_2 != 0 separates degree-2 from degree-1 (classical additive) measures; the cited phenomena supply both discriminators directly at the observational gate — observed single-particle fringes give I_2 != 0, and the three-slit experiment measures I_3 and bounds it below 10^-2 of two-path interference — so for any F1 theory reproducing them, the interference order is pinned to exactly 2 within the stated precision. The stamp is O because the structural discriminators (I_2, I_3) are themselves the measured quantities; no inference upward is used.
requirements.what_would_refute: Evasion side: an F1 formulation with microscopically non-zero I_3 suppressed below the current 10^-2 bound that reproduces all corpus phenomena — the requirement then survives only as the stated bound, never as exact bilinearity (it is deliberately worded as a bound for this reason); or demonstration that a phenomena-reproducing formulation without additive alternative structure covers the same evidence, reclassifying the requirement FORMULATION-RELATIVE. Dissolution side: experimental detection of third-order (Sorkin) interference above the bound, which breaks the arrow and with it the degree-2 probability structure of the standard formalism.

Firewalls respected: this forces neither complex amplitudes (complex amplitude != QM — the real-symplectic equivalence shows complexness is formulation choice) nor the Born weights (interference != Born — per the recorded Sinha caveat, which limits the evidence to pairwise interference structure).

Dissolution side: re-analysis or new data showing the single-particle detection statistics are additive over path alternatives (the fringe pattern a weighted sum of single-slit patterns), dissolving the phenomenon basis itself.

The requirement is on the reduction map, not on any particular choice of cells.
